_comment: Measured wall-clock seconds per integration suite, used to balance the CI
shards (legacy #868). Packing by COUNT put the four heaviest suites on one shard,
which then ran ~360s while another ran ~159s — and the suite that happened
to run last there (registration) started timing out under the load.
These are observations, not budgets. Nothing fails when a suite drifts past
its number; the packing just gets less even. Refresh them when the spread
gets bad, by reading the per-suite 'Duration' lines out of any green
A suite with no entry here gets DEFAULT_WEIGHT_SECONDS, so adding a suite
never breaks the matrix — it just packs a little less well until measured.
